title: alchemilla alpina var. alpigena
intro: Alchemilla alpina var. alpigena, commonly known as Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Alpine Lady's Mantle include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and reduce oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions include antiseptic, astringent, and hemostatic properties, with bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and tannins contributing to its medicinal effects.
